A day as a
giant tortoise

Take care of the Galápagos tortoise for a day: feed her, protect her from the hawk, take her to her mud bath, and help her babies hatch.

Galápagos Guardian!

Eats cactusSpines and all: her mouth is very tough.
Bony helmetShe hides in her shell when there is danger.
Over 100 yearsOne of the longest-living animals.
Eggs in the sunThe sun warms the nest and the babies hatch on their own.

Dogs, cats, and rats that came with people are their biggest danger. Let's take care of their home!
